messages:
leo: Kicking off a phased rollout for v3.14.0. Plan: US -> EU -> APAC. Deploy bot scheduled at 15:00 PT. Need warm pools + capacity confirmation and rollback criteria acknowledged.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: queued job id=dl-3412345678. plan: canary US 5% -> ramp to 50% over 30m, EU canary afterwards, APAC final. fallback pin: v3.13 if errors >1% sustained for 5m.

maria: Agree with the plan. Requesting warm pool reservations: US +60 GPUs, EU +30 GPUs, APAC +20 GPUs. Also ensure DB connection headroom for canaries.

alan: US warm pool +60 confirmed and warming (ETA ~12m). EU +30 reserved, warming (ETA ~22m). APAC +20 scheduled, warmup ETA ~28m. DB headroom: increasing connection pool in us-west first.

raj: Note: eu-west region has been at ~72% quota baseline today. We'll throttle non-critical routes during EU ramp. If quota >85% while ramping, hold and escalate.

deploy-bot: Pinned rollout config: 
```
canary: 5%
ramp: to 50% over 30m
rollback_triggers:
  - error_rate > 1% over 5m
  - p95_latency > 600ms over 5m
  - cost_per_token > baseline * 1.2
fallback_version: v3.13
```

leo: Rollback checklist: if triggered, ops will pin traffic back to v3.13 and open an incident if error_rate >1% or p95 breach persists >10m. Can we get an explicit :thumbsup: from SRE/Oncall?

elaine: Seen. We'll watch p95 and 4xx/5xx. Dashboard: https://grafana.redwood/boards/rollout-v3-14 (monitoring p95, errors, cpu/gpu util).

alan: Pinned v3.14.0 to us-canary group. If rollback fires, we'll rollback routing and pin to v3.13 at the LB layer.

maria: Release notes updated (short): tokenizer change required, embeddings might shift ~0.3% measured drift. Added migration step for offline embedding regen.

leo: Ops, SRE, infra - please confirm readiness or call holds now.

raj: :+1: Oncall green for US canary. We'll run smoke rules and keep rate caps on low-priority flows.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: starting canary in US (us-west-1) at 3412345678. canary-id=canary-3412.

ops-bot: ops-bot: smoke test results (canary-3412): p95=210ms, errors=0.12%, gpu_util=42%. All checks PASS.

raj: Saw a small spike in DB connections right at start, bumping pool to 150 connections in us-west.

alan: DB pool increased to 150. No connection failures observed after bump.

leo: If US remains stable for 30m, we'll promote EU canary. Target EU start +35m from now.

maria: EU canary scheduled in 35m. Warmup complete in EU in ~10m.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: EU canary starting at 3412348678. canary-id=canary-3412-eu.

ops-bot: ops-bot: EU smoke: p95=320ms, errors=0.25%, gpu_util=47%. Slightly higher latency but within threshold. Checks PASS.

raj: EU quota usage at 78% but autoscaling holding. If EU quota reaches 85% during ramp we will pause and shard traffic.

maria: APAC warm pool will be ready in ~12m after EU confirm. We'll do smaller slices there due to thermal constraints.

leo: APAC rule: if quota or thermal pressure >85%, switch to incremental 10% slices and hold between each. Also enable fallback region routing to nearest healthy region if necessary.

elaine: Monitoring: configuring alert runbook to notify SRE channel on any p95 breach >500ms for >3m.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: starting APAC canary at 3412349278. canary-id=canary-3412-apac. routing=ap-southeast-1.

ops-bot: ops-bot: APAC smoke: p95=290ms, errors=0.18%, gpu_util=55%. Thermal margins acceptable.

raj: Observed small cost bump in APAC due to increased seq length on canary requests. Tracking. Not a trigger yet.

alan: All region warm pools scaled down to steady state. No rollback actions taken.

leo: Final status: rollout succeeded across US/EU/APAC. v3.14.0 pinned as active. No rollback triggered. Thanks everyone — closing the rollout. If any follow-ups, add to the release ticket.

maria: Great work team. I'll publish the post-release notes and update changelog.

elaine: Closing monitoring loop, will keep a 24h watch for regressions.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: rollout complete for dl-3412345678. status=SUCCESS.

leo: thread closed. :party_parrot:
